Name: Misc Things Extended
Author: WhyBother11
Description:
Misc Things Extended adds miscellaneous stuff for mod authors to utilize in their mods.
[size=5]Installation[/size]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download the mod and extract it into StardewValley/Mods. [/*]
[/list][size=5]Mod author guide[/size]
[size=3]So far this mod features:[/size]
[list]
[*]Overriding things related to NPC gifting based on Game State Query conditions, such as gift taste, dialogue line and more, trigger actions to execute upon gift received.[/*]
[*]Map property for moving clock hands synchronized with in-game time.[/*]
[*]Custom fish to be caught on floor 100 of the Mines.[/*]
[/list]Source code is [url=https://github.com/WhyBother11/MiscThingsExtended/tree/master]here[/url]. Documentation is [url=https://github.com/WhyBother11/MiscThingsExtended/blob/master/README.md]here[/url].
If you are mod author and have ideas that would require framework, feel free to contact me here on Nexus or in SDV discord (@Pivaseek). If I think the idea is reasonable and will be useful (or if I just would like to do it), I'd be glad to help make it to life.
